title: Coverage Limits by Tier: LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy
content:
Every LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy tier sets the range within which Coverage A (the dwelling) may be written, the percentages that size Coverage B (other structures) and Coverage D (fair rental value), the ceiling on Coverage C for the landlord's furnishings and appliances, and the liability and medical payments amounts it offers.

## Limits table

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest Coverage A (USD) | 50,000 | 75,000 | 100,000 | 125,000 | 150,000 | 150,000 |
| Highest Coverage A (USD) | 300,000 | 400,000 | 600,000 | 750,000 | 1,000,000 | 1,500,000 |
| Coverage B other structures (percent of Coverage A) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Coverage D fair rental value (percent of Coverage A) | 10 | 10 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 30 |
| Longest period lost rent is paid after a covered loss (months) | 6 | 6 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 18 |
| Most Coverage C for landlord's furnishings and appliances (USD) | 5,000 | 10,000 | 15,000 | 20,000 | 25,000 | 50,000 |
| Premises liability limits offered (USD) | 100,000 or 300,000 | 100,000 or 300,000 | 300,000 or 500,000 | 300,000 or 500,000 | 500,000 or 1,000,000 | 500,000 or 1,000,000 |
| Medical payments per person (USD) | 1,000 | 1,000 | 2,500 | 2,500 | 5,000 | 5,000 |

The unformatted figures, for matching against the declarations: Coverage A floors 50000, 75000, 100000, 125000, 150000, 150000; Coverage A ceilings 300000, 400000, 600000, 750000, 1000000, 1500000; Coverage C ceilings 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 25000, 50000; medical payments 1000, 1000, 2500, 2500, 5000, 5000.

## How the percentages read

Coverage B and Coverage D are stated as percentages of the Coverage A written on the policy. On a hypothetical LandlordGuard DP-3 Special with Coverage A of 300,000 USD, Coverage B is 10 percent of it, 30,000 USD, and Coverage D is 20 percent of it, 60,000 USD; the same Coverage A on LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio gives Coverage D of 30 percent, 90,000 USD.

## Points of judgement

- A Coverage A figure is within range when it is not below the tier's lowest figure and not above its highest figure.
- Premises liability is one of the two amounts listed for the tier; the table offers no other amount.
- The lost-rent month limit and the Coverage D amount are separate ceilings; both are figures of the tier.
